opsHelp.infiltrate_spy: Plants an agent in the target country: gradually reveals its provinces, buildings and intentions.
opsHelp.recruit_source: Recruits a local source: regular intention reports, variable rating.
opsHelp.turn_agent: Turns an exposed enemy agent to feed false information to its service.
opsHelp.exfiltrate: Brings home a threatened agent before capture.
opsHelp.steal_research: Steals research work: speeds up or unlocks a node.
opsHelp.sabotage_factory: Damages an industrial building of the target.
opsHelp.fund_rebels: Funds a rebellion in a province: lowers stability.
opsHelp.listen_area: Radio intercepts over an area: reveals the units present.
opsHelp.intercept_army: Follows an army's transmissions: orders and movements.
opsHelp.jam_area: Jams communications and radars in an area.
opsHelp.cyber_production: Slows down the target's industrial production.
opsHelp.cyber_orders: Delays the execution of the target's orders.
opsHelp.disinformation: Disinformation campaign: lowers the target's stability.
opsHelp.leak_plans: Publishes stolen plans on the world news wire.
opsHelp.plant_fake_report: Gets a fake report to the opposing service.
opsHelp.deploy_decoys: Deploys decoys that fool enemy reconnaissance.
opsHelp.fake_radio_traffic: Simulates radio traffic to mask your movements.
opsHelp.counterintel_sweep: Hunts foreign agents on your territory.
opsHelp.recon_economic: Reveals in phases the economic facilities (production, resources, industry) of an entire country — capital and major cities first, then the rest — or of a single province.
opsHelp.recon_military: Reveals in phases the bases, air defenses, radars, silos and bunkers of an entire country — capital and major cities first, then the rest — or of a single province. Then visible on the map.
opsHelp.cryptanalysis: Gradually breaks a nation's encryption: at 25% its movement orders become readable, at 50% its intentions. Strong encryption (advanced services) slows progress.
opsHelp.intercept_comms: Intercepts a nation's communications: traffic volume, movement orders and war plans depending on decryption. A strong enemy counterintelligence can inject fake traffic.
opsHelp.geolocate_emitters: Locates a nation's radars, air defenses and command posts from their emissions. SIGINT satellites and aircraft in service increase the number of emitters found.
opsHelp.cultivate_source: Raises a reliable agent's access: ministry (budget, research), then general staff (war plans). The higher the access, the more exposed the agent.
opsHelp.vet_agents: Checks your agents in a country: unmasks double agents and spots those under surveillance. No risk.
opsHelp.designate_targets: Imagery analysis of an enemy province: forces identified and located, facilities mapped, strikes proposed unit by unit.
opsHelp.dismantle_network: Dismantles a nation's network on your soil: arrests agents already spotted and hunts the others.
opsHelp.deception_plan: Feeds fake war plans to enemy services. More credible if the enemy has agents in your country, especially a turned agent.
opsHelp.harden_sites: Strengthens protection of all your facilities for a few days: sabotage, rebel funding and industrial cyberattacks are hampered.
